name: io.github.ravidsrk/slop-detect-mcp
description: MCP server that scores any landing page against the AI-design-slop fingerprint (deterministic 0-100, real Chromium), copy tells, DESIGN.md system compliance, and AEO technical eligibility, and builds remediation prompts.

transport.notes: Local stdio MCP server (npm: slop-detect-mcp) or zero-install remote Streamable HTTP endpoint at https://slop-detect.com/mcp.

tools.name: scan_page
tools.description: Score a URL against the default-template design fingerprint (optionally the copy and DESIGN.md axes). Returns score, tier, grade, and triggered patterns.

tools.name: check_aeo
tools.description: Score technical eligibility for AI search and user-action crawlers (robots.txt RFC 9309, snippet controls, server-rendered prose, markdown twin, llms.txt). Higher is better.

tools.name: check_design_system
tools.description: Check whether a page honors its own declared design system (a DESIGN.md file). Returns a 0-100 compliance score (higher is better) plus named drift: undeclared fonts, off-palette CTA colors, off-scale radii.

tools.name: fix_prompt
tools.description: Build a ready-to-paste prompt or concise <=120-word avoid brief instructing a coding agent how to de-slop a page.

tools.name: lint_design_md
tools.description: Statically lint a DESIGN.md document for broken token references, component contrast below 4.5:1, orphaned palette tokens, and specVersion issues.

tools.name: diff_design_md
tools.description: Diff two DESIGN.md documents and report added, removed, and changed tokens.

tools.name: extract_design_system
tools.description: Extract a starter DESIGN.md and DTCG 2025.10 tokens.json from a scanned page or system context.

resources.name: Slop Detector Editorial-Instrument Score Card (MCP App)

prompts.name: audit_landing_page
prompts.description: Run a full 4-axis audit (Design + Copy + DESIGN.md System Compliance + AEO Eligibility) on a URL.

prompts.name: deslop_and_verify
prompts.description: Closed-loop workflow: scan a page, generate a remediation prompt, apply fixes, and re-verify.
